prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is paint_mask_guide.png (first input); design_reference.png is appearance reference (second); icon_x8.png is original colour reference (third). Preserve the guide exactly, including the unusual end-on and edge-on views. Do not substitute front-facing daggers in these cells. Generate the image according to this exact brief:
# Trolleri: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10185/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the strongly curved pale blade, gold-and-red jeweled guard, curved orange-gold handle, and blue jewel in the hooked round pommel. Render one complete Trolleri on genuine transparent alpha without straightening or generic substitution..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the strongly curved pale blade, gold-and-red jeweled guard, curved orange-gold handle, and blue jewel in the hooked round pommel. Render one complete Trolleri on genuine transparent alpha without straightening or generic substitution.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10185/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

CORRECTIVE PASS: Match the guide's alpha silhouettes precisely. Absolutely no stray pixels, coloured fringes, speckles, or marks outside those silhouettes. Keep the original guard location and exact blade/handle proportions in the guide. Preserve every outline without ornament protrusions. The lower mask duplicates the exact upper silhouettes. Orange-gold metallic handle and raised bands are METAL, so use pure RED for these in the masks; gemstones only pure BLACK. The end-on blade cross-section is metal RED, not a black gem. Paint must be unlit flat base colour without hot highlights. Retain the exact three-column four-row layout, with empty rightmost cells in rows two and four.
validation: Visual inspection: layout retained, but stray edge pixels and silhouette deviations remain; raw output preserved without postprocessing.
